ops.note: 881c186. One classifier, service/launchctl.go:launchctlOutcome, returning Loaded|NotLoaded|Refused|InFlux|Unknown(code). The boundary is unbypassable rather than merely conventional: both launchctl methods now return a launchctlResult instead of (string, error), so no call site can classify launchd itself. shExit was deleted, not fixed — launchctlExit already built the real type in the same package and shExit forked /bin/sh per table entry.
